_doc: The recurring cast (relationship system, scripts/career/relationships.gd). Each person has a relationship value 0-100 (start 50 = neutral; numbers in career_tuning.tres, 'Relationships') saved per career in CareerData.people, and story flags in CareerData.flags. Fields: id (used in scenario data: choices 'rel': {coach: 5}, requirements min/max 'rel_coach': 60, and {coach} in scenario text = the person's name), role (shown on the People screen; 'roles' overrides it per stage), icon (UiIcons), name: fixed text, or style coach ('Coach' + a last name), full (first + last), first, or list (pick from 'names' below), stages (where this person exists; default all), per_stage (a new person each stage; the old one moves to 'Former'), known_at_start (false = hidden on the People screen until a scenario changes the value), tiers (labels from a minimum value; default 'tiers' below).
